description: Receives eight signals without cables from a Teleport In module picked by label

outputs.text: Carries whatever is patched into the matching input of the chosen Teleport In module

notes: Click the text box to open a menu headed Select source, listing (none) and the label of every Teleport In module in the patch; this menu is on the text box, not the panel
the lamp beside an output is green while the matching input at the Teleport In end has a cable in it and red while it does not
With no Teleport In module anywhere in the patch, or with the source set to (none), all eight outputs rest at 0V and every lamp is dark
